description: With the settled-flip cure the distiller reaches a panic at src/compiler2/jobs/runtime_demand.rs:1294 (index out of bounds: the len is 0 but the index is 0; out.input_demands[index].join_assign). input_demands is sized by executable.activation.input_len(types) (~1228) while the clause has params. Also panics without the cure on /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/runaway/d5.fz. Culprit activation and minimal program: being identified (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/census/panic_min.fz).
